title: Upstream source group
description: One file per update group under _meta/sources/. Groups are the unit of update checking (src/check_updates.py) — bodies update at different rates, and new agencies join by adding group files, never by changing tools.

kind.description: sp-listing: diff a SharePoint listing snapshot AND content-hash members; content-hash: hash members only; chapter-html: hash shared chapter snapshots (members may be sections of one snapshot)

recheck.description: How often this group is rechecked, and what each value means: biennial = 730 days, the ORS edition, published after each ODD-YEAR legislative session; even_year_general_election = 765 days, constitutional amendments referred to voters and decided at the general election, November of EVEN-numbered years; monthly = 30 days, the Oregon Bulletin, first business day of each month; on_review_date = 365 days, a document carrying its own printed review date, with the year as a backstop re-crawl rather than a signal; quarterly = 90 days, a listing that moves a few times a year; weekly = 7 days, a listing that moves within a week. GENERATED from CADENCES in src/check_updates.py by `python3 src/check_updates.py --sync-schema`, and gated by `--check`: a value here that the checker declares no interval for is a group nothing can report a due-state for.

listing_snapshot.description: sp-listing groups: path to the normalized listing snapshot JSON (carries the REST endpoint, view GUIDs, rows, and checker field config)

upstream_signal.description: Human note: what upstream mechanism announces changes and how often it moves

id.description: Document id, or shared snapshot id for chapter-html groups

sample_cursor.description: Where the rolling sample of un-named rules resumes next seeding run (#256). Advances by the sample size and wraps, so coverage accumulates instead of resampling the same rules every month.

seeded_from.description: The Bulletin whose worklist this group's population was derived from (#256), so a manifest and the notice it is compared against can be checked for agreement.
